# SatUByte <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Math](Language-Features-Math)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SatUByte(value)
SatUByte:UInt8(value)
```

**Returns:** The number, or the closest number of the type if it does not fit.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

<!-- AUTOGENERATED COPYRIGHT HEADER START -->
Converts a number or a text to a UByte (0 to 255) and stops at 0 and 255 instead of wrapping around. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no integers of other sizes. A whole number outside the range becomes the closest number of the range, and a real is rounded to the nearest whole number (halves go to the even one) first. A real that is not a number becomes 0. [UByte](UByte) does the same for a real, but wraps whole numbers around.

## Differences

* Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print SatUByte(100)
Print SatUByte(300)
Print SatUByte(-5)
```

```text
100
255
0
```
